title: Full-width pointer-events:auto overlay band swallows clicks meant for the player — keep the band pointer-events:none on all devices and drag via a dedicated handle
trigger: A shadow-DOM overlay band/row covering part of a video has pointer-events:auto (e.g. as a drag surface), and on touch devices taps into that band never reach the player — play/pause/toggle-controls appear dead under the covered region
principle: pointer-events:auto on a wide overlay container consumes every pointer hit inside its box — the host page below never sees the tap. On touch, tap-to-toggle-controls is THE primary player gesture, and on desktop a dead band still blocks click-to-pause on the covered region — so the robust default is pointer-events:none on the band on ALL devices, with pointer-events:auto only on the interactive children (buttons, text, handles). Keep the drag affordance with a dedicated handle element (e.g. a DragHandle pinned to the block) that captures the pointer immediately for every pointer type, plus deferred-capture triggers (subtitle block on touch, collapsed nav pill) where a sub-threshold gesture must still resolve as a normal tap/click (word lookup, expand, text selection). Hit-test inside shadow DOM via shadowRoot.elementFromPoint — document.elementFromPoint retargets to the host, and note it returns the underlying PAGE element (e.g. VIDEO) when the shadow tree doesn't intercept, not null.

cases.context: SubtitlePanels .root band (full video width, ~74px, pointer-events:auto + touch-action:none) existed to drag-reposition subtitles. On a 203px-tall mobile YouTube player it swallowed ~36% of the tap area — users could not toggle the native controls scrim at all and reported 'lớp che không thể thao tác'.

Verification probe: document.elementFromPoint inside the video rect returned #cell-subtitle-root (retargeted from the .root shadow child); shadowRoot.elementFromPoint revealed the real hit (band vs button vs subtitle .layer).
cases.bad:
// assumed host pointer-events:none meant click-through — but a shadow child with
// pointer-events:auto still intercepts; document.elementFromPoint only shows the host
